reviews.author: Aman Tripathi
reviews.text: Awesome gym kiran & Rishab professional trainer. Eat sleep gym repeat visit the gym once absolutely everyone will like it

reviews.author: Kavita Kalkate
reviews.text: Overall very Good experience, all trainer are certified and nicely guided to do our best. Equipment are latest and gym are well maintained. Taking good care of basic hygiene, discipline. Very safe place for women to join gym. Trainers are very polite, humble and at the same time strict to bring best out of you. I will recommend to join ORK gym.

reviews.author: Sonali Chaudhary
reviews.text: ORK is one of the best gym, all trainer are certified. Trainer Mr. Rishab, Mr. Kiran, Mr. Darshan and Mr. Tanmay are very polite, respectful, humble and giving best training. Gym are neat and clean, basic hygiene maintained. Best and safe place for women. Latest equipment for gym is available. I recommend you all to join gym. Thank you

reviews.author: Shraddha Patil
reviews.text: This ORK gym is awesome - great equipment and always clean. Such a great workout and the trainers are very helpful in teaching the correct form. I would definitely recommend ORK Fitness to anyone looking for a new gym in Kalher.

reviews.author: Raj Dubey
reviews.text: Nice gym....well equipped. Trainers are good. When I joined ORK FITNESS my weight was 116kg and today 8th April 2022 my weight is 91kg. In guidance of Rishabh Sir and Kiran sir I lost 25kg in 4 months. Thanks to both Sir!!! Feeling great. I highly recommend ORK FITNESS to all fitness lovers.

reviews.author: Vikram Jhuria
reviews.text: Well equipped gym with professional trainers who have good knowledge. Perfect for beginners as well as fitness freaks. Trainers understand your needs and accordingly help you attain your goals with your pace. Has multiple gym equipments starting from cardio to weights, covers everything.

reviews.author: Ayush Patil
reviews.text: Its a great gym for every age group and gender. The trainers are very skilled and have a great expertise in handling weights. The crowd in the gym is also very friendly and helpful.

reviews.author: Hrishikesh Lad
reviews.text: This gym is amazing. Amazing facility, top equipment and great environment. Good service with friendly staff and super clean and comfortable gym for everyone from beginners to professional athletes to trainers.
